summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces. In rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ returns bool(ref.startswith(self)) (prefix test, reference as receiver); ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns any(ref == uri for uri in self.__uris.values()) (node-type-aware closed membership, inherited by _RDFNamespace); _ipython_key_completions_ now returns dir(self.uri). NamespaceManager left unchanged. In test/test_namespace.py: added test_namespace_prefix_membership, test_closed_namespace_membership_rdfs (positive, undefined-sharing-base, plain string and Literal negatives), and test_closed_namespace_membership_rdf (rdf:type positive, rdf:_1 negative), with new imports RDF, RDFS, SH, Namespace, Literal. Tests were NOT run, per instructions; verification is by reading only. No commits made.
